pageTextAfter: Rental  Agreement   Summary  This  summary  covers  the  lease  of  the  second  floor  apartment  at   42  Oak  Avenue.   The  lease  begins  on  the  first  day  of  June  and  runs  for  twelve  months,   ending  on  the  last  day  of  May  next   year.  The  monthly  rent  is  due   on  the  first  of  each  month  and  may  be  paid  by   check  or  bank  transfer.  A  late  fee  will  apply  if  payment  is  more  than  nine  days  late.  The  security  deposit  equals  one  month  of  rent.  The  tenant  is  responsible  for  electricity  and  internet   service.  The  landlord  pays  for  water, trash  pickup,  and  yard  care.  Pets  are  allowed  with   written  approval  and  a  small  extra  deposit.  Either   party  may  end  the  lease  early  with  sixty  days  of  written   notice.  Please  keep  this  summary  with  your  signed  copy  of  the  full  agreement  for  future  reference.

lines.text: Rental Agreement Summary
This summary covers the lease of the second floor apartment at 42 Oak Avenue. The
lease begins on the first day of June and runs for twelve months, ending on the last day of
May next year.
The monthly rent is due on the first of each month and may be paid by check or bank
transfer. A late fee will apply if payment is more than five days late. The security deposit
equals one month of rent.
The tenant is responsible for electricity and internet service. The landlord pays for water,
trash pickup, and yard care. Pets are allowed with written approval and a small extra
deposit.
Either party may end the lease early with sixty days of written notice. Please keep this
summary with your signed copy of the full agreement for future reference.
